text:
maya: quick one — can we swap our Dec release slot? current slot is Wed Dec 15 10:00 PT but eng-sre + several US folks will be out that week. proposing Mon Dec 20 10:00 PT instead.

stella: who currently owns the 12/20 slot?

maya: platform team has it (I think @jon). we only need a 30–45m window, patch release + small db migration. changelog PR is open but not merged.

jon: yup 12/20 was reserved for platform. if you can confirm no infra maintenance that week we can trade. what are the cutoff dates if we move?

maya: cutoff for rc build is Fri Dec 10 17:00 PT. target ship date if swapped = 12/20 10:00 PT. rollback window +30m.

ravi: changelog note: PR #2456 (feature: reduce kv cache memory) still needs a version bump in `package.json` and helm chart. can someone take that?

sam: I can do the version bump and push before cutoff, but need someone to approve the PR — @stella can you review by 12/09? :eyes:

stella: sure, I'll prioritize review on 12/09 morning PT. please add the changelog entry under "fixed" and tag QA.

maya: proposed calendar snippet:

```
Proposed swap:
- Move release: Dec 15 10:00 PT -> Dec 20 10:00 PT
- Cutoff (rc): Dec 10 17:00 PT
- QA verification window: Dec 13-14
- Rollback: first 30 min post-deploy
- Bridge coverage: assign EMEA -> @leo, US -> @sam
```

leo: EMEA can cover on 12/20 morning (my timezone), but we need 1 extra person for the first 20m just in case. @jon can you confirm platform has a +1?

jon: we can spare @ravi for the 20m. also check infra: there is a small network maintenance dec 18 in eu-west but shouldn't affect 12/20.

ravi: confirm happy to be backup on 12/20. will monitor the job after deploy.

devops-bot: calendar conflict check: found no hard conflicts for platform 12/20 10:00 PT. auto-created tentative event: https://calendar.company/evt/abc123 :calendar: (please accept)

maya: thanks all — two action items: 1) @sam do the version bump + link PR to changelog, 2) @stella review by 12/09. if both green I'll open a swap request with release ops and tag infra for final clear.

sam: will do version bump today and cc QA in the PR description.

stella: review scheduled.

jon: I'll notify platform team and add @ravi as backup bridge.

maya: pinging release-ops: request to swap our 12/15 slot with platform's 12/20 slot. holding until PR + review done, but want this noted now. @release-ops please advise if we need to escalate.

devops-bot: release-ops notified: ticket created #RELEASE-842. status: pending approval.

maya: update — PR merged, version bump done, changelog updated. opening the formal swap request now.

devops-bot: release-ops approved swap. calendar updated: Dec 20 10:00 PT now reserved for Redwood release (was Dec 15).

leo: confirmed, updated my calendar and slack status for bridge. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks team — closing thread.
